title: Lifted tensor-section sheaves have zero positive finite affine Cech cohomology
statement: Let X be a scheme, F a quasi-coherent X-module and G the universe lift of its associated tensor-section sheaf [def-sc-etale-qcoherent-module]. For U,I,V,f belonging to the finite affine cover collection of [new-etale-finite-affine-cech-basis], the Mathlib Cech complex of G restricted along Over.forget U has zero homology in every positive natural degree p. No affineness of X is assumed.

source.place: Etale Cohomology Theorem Tag 03P2 affine case; Lemma Tag 03OZ; original parent proof step 2

proof.text: Pull back F to the affine U; it is quasi-coherent. Tensor pullback composition identifies the restriction of F_et on Over U with the tensor-section sheaf of that pullback; coherence of the restrictions identifies their Cech maps.

Replace the finite affine cover by its disjoint union. The standard-cover comparison supplies an affine faithfully flat one-map cover and a Cech-complex isomorphism. Affine fibre-product and pullback-section formulas identify the latter complex with the Amitsur complex of the section module of the pullback of F to U. The tensor-section restrictions are the face maps, by their pullback-composition definition. Reindex the finite family by Fin n to meet the small-universe index of etale_standard_cover_cech. The equivalence between the small etale site of U and the over category over U preserves finite products; unique isomorphisms of chosen product cones compare SiteCechComplex with Mathlib cechComplexFunctor and commute with face maps.

Apply faithfully flat Amitsur exactness in every positive degree. Lifting the groups and maps preserves exactness: unlift a cocycle, choose an underlying preimage and lift it back; finite products of lifted section groups identify with the lifts of finite products. Transport the resulting zero homology along the complex comparison. Empty covers only occur over the empty affine U, where section modules are zero.

theorem isZero_etaleTensorSectionsSheaf_ulift_cech
    (X : Scheme.{u}) (F : X.Modules) [F.IsQuasicoherent]
    (U : X.Etale) (I : Type (u + 1)) (V : I → X.Etale) (f : ∀ i : I, V i ⟶ U)
    (hf : finiteAffineEtaleCechCover X U I V f) (p : ℕ) (hp : 0 < p) :
    IsZero (((cechComplexFunctor fun i : I ↦ Over.mk (f i)).obj
      ((Over.forget U).op ⋙
        ((sheafCompose X.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.uliftFunctor.{u + 1, u}).obj
          (Modules.etaleTensorSectionsSheaf F)).obj)).homology p)
